conclusion.conclusion: The most evidence-supported explanation for the 2026-08-31 drop in the east/full_service (华东正餐) redemption conversion rate is the end of the merchant incentive activity. The activity activity-east-full-service-summer (merchant_incentive for merchant synthetic-merchant-east-full-service, region east, category full_service) ended on 2026-08-30. The confirmation→redemption rate for east/full_service fell from ~0.82 (stable through 08-30) to 0.344 on 08-31 and 0.347 on 09-01, while upstream stages (visit, enrollment, confirmation rates) stayed normal and confirmations remained high (413 on 08-31) with redemptions collapsing to 142. The drop is isolated to east/full_service: north/full_service (0.699), east/beverage (0.684), and east/quick_service (0.687) on 08-31 were all normal, and the market benchmark for east/full_service was stable (+0.003463). This is an observational attribution based on the exact temporal coincidence of the incentive end and the isolated single-stage drop; no direct mechanism record linking the incentive removal to redemption behavior was returned.
